notes.title: Map Completed Horizon's Edge!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the map for Horizon's Edge is done! The map size is 8x8 km. This huge map offers endless exploration and adventure.

Top View

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921662/6b4577912a5bdfecd80953249eed1a58b56e200e.png

Next, we’re adding detailed foliage to make the landscapes even more beautiful. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to improve Horizon's Edge!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921662/6a52904f73dfd629c3a57bab97b816cdf1e5295a.png

notes.title: Exciting News: Horizon's Edge New Logo!
notes.content:
New Logo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921662/f5a6758e383a2807eb6d5733c2364ea85d68f2cc.png

We are excited to share some fantastic news with you! Our game, Horizon's Edge, has a brand-new logo. This new design captures the heart of our game, showcasing what makes it special and exciting.
